The walls are decorated with colorful patterns and there are rows of bookshelves on the right side of the image. On the left side, there is a large screen displaying a man in a suit and tie. In the center of the room, there are several orange chairs and tables arranged in a semi-circle. People are sitting at the tables and some are standing, while others are sitting on the floor. The overall atmosphere of the restaurant is casual and relaxed.
